name: Los Poblanos
aka: Los Poblanos Historic Inn & Organic Farm

location.text: Los Ranchos de Albuquerque, New Mexico

dates.altered: An adobe ranch house remodelled by Meem in 1932 for Albert and Ruth Hanna McCormick Simms, enclosing an L-plan into a full courtyard with a portal; La Quinta, a single-storey H-shaped entertaining pavilion, designed 1934 (Los Poblanos' own pages and the Meem works list).
dates.note: The Meem works list on Wikipedia prints '"Los Poblanos", Simms Residence ... Los Ranchos (1932)' and '"La Quinta" Pavilion at "Los Poblanos", Los Ranchos (1934)'. The exemplar year is 1934.

refs.title: Los Poblanos Historic Inn & Organic Farm - Wikipedia
refs.note: 'Los Poblanos is listed on the New Mexico State Register of Cultural Properties and The National Register of Historic Places.' The plain title 'Los Poblanos' answered 404.

refs.note: Owner. note: Added 4 Sep 2026 as Meem's domestic Pueblo Revival at its most complete -- a full placita house with portal, in adobe -- for a node whose four exemplars were all institutional. No HABS record was found.
